name: Virtual Voxel
definition: A rasterization-based voxel renderer that enables real-time rendering of 4^12 resolution voxel scenes by combining virtual texture and virtual geometry concepts to stream appropriate level of detail into GPU memory while storing data linearly.
summary: Virtual Voxel is a rasterization-based renderer that enables real-time modification of large voxel scenes by streaming data via a two-level structure, differing from prior graph-based methods.
